entities.summary: Morocco is a sovereign nation in North Africa, Africa. Its capital is Rabat. Official languages include Arabic, Berber (Tamazight). Government: Unitary parliamentary constitutional monarchy. Population: approximately 37.8 million. Area: 446,550 km². Comprehensive index for Morocco covering Berber heritage, Phoenician/Roman Mauretania, Arab conquest, Idrisid dynasty, Almoravid/Almohad empires, Marinid/Saadian/Alaouite dynasties, French/Spanish protectorates, independence under Mohammed V, Hassan II's Years of Lead, and Western Sahara claim.
